高考英语3500词 · 02英文原文

Different Countries Have Different Kinds of English

不同国家的英语各有不同 · 156 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Voyages by people from England played an important part in spreading the English language. At present, English is frequently spoken as an official or common language in many countries, such as America, Singapore, Malaysia and some African countries. The varieties of English spoken in these countries have roots in British English and are generally easy for native English speakers to understand. But actually, these varieties have gradually developed differences in accent, spelling, expressions and vocabulary use.

2Because of this fact, you can make use of the differences to tell which country the foreigners in your neighbourhood are from. For example, if a boss fluently commands his driver, “Come up straight to my apartment by elevator and take some gas for my trucks and cabs”, instead of requesting, “Please come to my flat by lift and take some petrol for my lorries and taxis”, you may recognise the first wording as American and the second as British.

高考英语3500词 · 02中文译文

不同国家的英语各有不同

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1英国人的航海活动对英语的传播起了重要作用。如今，在美国、新加坡、马来西亚和一些非洲国家，英语经常作为官方语言或通用语言使用。这些地方的英语都以英式英语为基础，以英语为母语的人听起来并不费力。不过，各地的英语在口音、拼写、表达方式和词汇用法上，逐渐有了各自的变化。

2有了这些差别，你可以从街区里外国人的说法推测他们来自哪个国家。比如，一位老板流利地吩咐司机：“直接搭电梯（elevator）上我的公寓（apartment），拿些汽油（gas）给我的卡车（trucks）和出租车（cabs）。”另一种说法是：“请搭电梯（lift）来我的公寓（flat），拿些汽油（petrol）给我的卡车（lorries）和出租车（taxis）。”前一种用词听起来像美国人，后一种则更像英国人。
